sections.heading: Stopoperator
sections.content: The Stop operator allows you to stop a particle from moving or spinning.

sections.heading: Stop Motion
sections.content:
Velocity X/Y/Z: controls which axis of the velocity channel will be set to zero.Spin X/Y/Z: controls which axis of the spin channel will be set to zero.

Velocity X/Y/Z: controls which axis of the velocity channel will be set to zero.

Spin X/Y/Z: controls which axis of the spin channel will be set to zero.
